Name: Delivery Method ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the delivery method. Only available when updating existing delivery methods.

Name: Communication Delivery Method
Description: The communication method, such as e-mail or phone.

Name: Person Number
Description: The person number of the person to whom this delivery method relates.

Name: Preferred Order
Description: The preferred order for the communication delivery method.

Name: Person ID
Description: A unique reference to the person to whom this delivery method relates.

Name: Address Line 1
Description: The first line of the address.

Name: Address Type
Description: The address type.

Name: Communication Delivery Address
Description: The address associated with the delivery method, such as the IM identifier or the URL of a home page. Not used when CommDlvryMethod is e-mail, phone, or address.

Name: Delivery Method Reference ID
Description: If the delivery method is e-mail, address, or phone, a reference to the e-mail, address, or phone record.

Name: E-mail Address
Description: The e-mail address.

Name: E-mail Type
Description: The e-mail type, such as work or home.

Name: End Date
Description: The end date of the delivery method.

Name: Phone Number
Description: The phone number.

Name: Phone Type
Description: The phone type, such as home or mobile.

Name: Start Date
Description: The start date of the delivery method.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.

Name: Reference 1
Description: A user-defined reference value used for reporting and reconciling your data in the staging tables. This information is not saved in the application. You name your reference on the METADATA line using the format Attribute name = Reference name. For example, SourceRef001=Assignment Number.
